section.description: The section id you were asked to write.

markdown.description: The section body as Markdown, starting at heading level 2. Only facts established by the survey you were given; never invent a file, command, flag or symbol.

unknowns.description: Facts this section needs that the survey did not establish. They are written into the handbook as explicit gaps rather than guessed.

missing_snippets.description: Repo-relative files that would let you finish this section.
